text: 🤩 The Grand Unifying Architecture of Frontend SolidJS's creator argues that HTMX, React, LiveView, and friends differ mostly in how they split the same three jobs (navigation, content, and instant UI feedback) between client and server. He then shows how Solid 2.0 aims to cover the whole spectrum. Ryan Carniato

😮 How Anthropic Made Claude's Apps 3x Faster in Two Weeks A grab bag of performance lessons from a sprint that cut p75 'time-to-typeable' from 3.1s to 0.55s. Em dashes (the irony!) pushed V8 onto a slower regex path, a stray location.reload() caused half a million hidden reloads a day, and more. Wang, Attard, and G (Anthropic)

CHALLENGE class Counter { #count = 0; static #instances = 0; constructor() { Counter.#instances++; } #increment() { this.#count++; } incrementAndGet() { this.#increment(); return this.#count; } static get total() { return Counter.#instances; } } class SpecialCounter extends Counter { incrementAndGet() { return super.incrementAndGet() * 2; } } const c1 = new Counter(); const c2 = new SpecialCounter(); console.log(`${c1.incrementAndGet()} ${c2.incrementAndGet()} ${Counter.total}`);
